payload.title: MC-PCA on non-detrended speleothem data
payload.summary: This Jupyter Notebook performs an analysis of speleothem oxygen isotope data using the Monte Carlo Principal Component Analysis (MC-PCA) method. It utilizes pre-existing pickle files containing the data and separates the speleothem records into two sets, excluding certain records based on criteria such as length. The notebook applies MC-PCA to these datasets and visualizes the results using various plotting techniques.
goals: Analyze speleothem oxygen isotope data using MC-PCA
Visualize the results of the MC-PCA analysis

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook provides an analysis of speleothem oxygen isotope data using the MC-PCA method. It assumes the existence of pre-created pickle files and separates the data into two sets for analysis, excluding certain records based on specific criteria. The MC-PCA is applied to these datasets, and the results are visualized.
